hero.title: A calm control surface for reviewable paper workflows.
hero.summary: One authenticated local workspace connects the existing backend-owned research, governance, paper, portfolio, comparison, and lifecycle workflows.

boundary.title: Review first. Operate deliberately.
boundary.description: The browser uses the versioned FastAPI contract through a fixed same-origin gateway. Completed artifacts and backend domain services remain authoritative.

startup.title: Standard or isolated Demo Workspace
startup.description: Operators choose clean real-user storage or a separately named disposable Demo volume. This page never seeds or initializes either workspace.

health.title: API connectivity
health.checkingMessage: Checking the FastAPI process through the same-origin gateway…
health.availableMessage: The local API process is responding on the versioned health endpoint.
health.unavailableGuidance: Start FastAPI on loopback, then retry.

firstRun.checkingStandard: Checking the Standard Workspace for saved evidence…
firstRun.dataUnavailableTitle: Workspace data is unavailable, not empty
firstRun.standardAvailableDescription: Continue with the review workspaces below. These records are not automatically connected to one another.
firstRun.emptyTitle: The application is running, but no workspace evidence has been loaded yet.
firstRun.emptyDescription: Empty is a valid first-run state. It differs from an unavailable, invalid, or failed research root, evidence root, or product database.
firstRun.emptyGuidance: Choose either the isolated Demo Workspace through the documented terminal commands, or load or create real artifacts through documented operator workflows. This page never seeds data, writes artifacts, or initializes storage.
firstRun.demoWarning: Demo only — disposable example evidence, not real user data or trading advice.
firstRun.comparisonStep: {step}. Compare the two ordered demo results
firstRun.lifecycleStep: {step}. Prepare a proposal and record explicit human decision evidence
firstRun.demoBoundary: Each link comes from the validated backend descriptor. No fixture identity or evidence payload is defined in the browser.
